findings.description: Muted text colour (#c3c8cd) on white/light grey is about 1.6:1 contrast, far below WCAG AA 4.5:1. It affects the 'Signed in as ...' line, the table column headers (Title/Category/Amount/Actions) and every category value, so key information is nearly unreadable.
repro: Look at 'Signed in as' line, table headers and the category column

findings.description: A long expense title is not wrapped or truncated (white-space: nowrap in a fixed-layout table). On desktop it overlaps the Category and Amount cells; on a 360 px phone it overflows the card and makes the page scroll horizontally (scrollWidth 674 vs 360).
repro: Add expense with a very long title (about 85 characters) and amount 1234567.89
View /expenses at 1280 px and at 360 px

notes: Test expense was deleted afterwards. Totals and category filter were arithmetically correct. Not exhaustively tested: edit flow validation, touch target sizes, screen reader behaviour. Minor unreported: Delete buttons all labelled just 'Delete' with no row context, no confirmation on delete.

cost.notes: estimate from 25890 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0052-$0.0621
